title: Affine sign function
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$, a sign $\sigma\in\mathbb Z^\times$, and $\gamma\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$, the affine sign function is the function on $(\mathbb F_2)^n$ obtained by applying the affine sign modulation determined by $\sigma$ and $\gamma$ to the constant function with value $1$.
caveat: The definition of affine sign modulation is not included in the supplied snippet, so its pointwise formula cannot be recovered.
